focus: Chasing the fallout from the Anthropic IPO and new AI agent screenshot protections while tracking hardware and regional shifts.

priorities.why: Official closing of Anthropic's record IPO and private placement closes out the week's biggest market test.
Signal's move to block AI agents from reading chats via default screenshot restrictions marks a key privacy frontline.
Frostbite CPU architecture represents a major milestone: designed, discovered, and verified entirely by AI.
Deutsche Telekom's $109M investment in Mistral AI highlights telecom capital moving directly into European foundation models.
Pragmatik Labs hitting a $5B valuation underscores rapid capital concentration in Chinese AI labs.
